description: This file implements the RFCURLObserver class responsible for fetching configuration URLs, managing security tokens, and subscribing to device management update notifications within a Text-to-Speech system. It includes methods for retrieving environment/config data, handling notifications, and singleton instantiation.

classes.name: RFCURLObserver
classes.description: Manages configuration URL fetching, security token retrieval, and device management notifications for Text-to-Speech.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RFCURLObserver.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::triggerRFC
methods.description: Initiates configuration fetch and starts notification registration in a separate thread.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::fetchURLFromConfig
methods.description: Fetches the RFC URL from configuration and updates the default configuration.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, either from environment, config file, or via external utility functions.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::registerNotification
methods.description: Subscribes to device management update notifications, retrying on failure.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::onDeviceMgtUpdateReceivedHandler
methods.description: Handles device management update notifications, triggering URL fetch if source is 'rfc'.

methods.name: RFCURLObserver::~RFCURLObserver
methods.description: Cleans up resources, notably deleting the system service link.
